analysis: Examined all supplied metadata, patches and source excerpts. The changes are documentation: changelog.d/overlapped-weight-verification.md:3–9 describes overlapped SHA-256 reads across registration, downloads and fresh model-load verification; docs/reference/configuration.md's patch at head:602–606 specifies a reader thread and two page-aligned 4 MiB buffers per hashed file while retaining uncached reads and existing fallbacks. No executable control change or independently supported security regression is visible. Relevant contracts are weight integrity against operator substitution (A-004, T-012, T-027, TB-003/TB-007), availability under concurrent hashing (A-018), and verified weight identity binding for encrypted SSD prefixes (T-041). Surrounding configuration excerpts retain explicit cache selection, verified-weight records and serving/attestation gates; the patch does not alter authorization, encryption, account scoping, billing or cache policy. Implementation is not supplied, so unchanged digest and bounded-memory claims are not verified. Integration should examine WeightHasher.hashSingleFileUncached and OverlappedFileDigest for buffer ownership/synchronization, short-read and error handling, complete ordered hashing, reader termination and concurrency bounds, and confirm fresh pre/post-load hashes still enforce the SSD weight binding. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of a missing control; no unrelated unchanged implementation review is requested.
